dict.string: Erosion uses the local network for Airlift device pairing.
Erosion is testing the iOS microphone permission prompt. Prepare does not record audio.
Erosion is testing the iOS camera permission prompt. Prepare does not capture images.
Erosion is testing the Photos access prompt. Prepare does not read or modify your photo library.
Erosion is testing the location permission prompt. Prepare does not collect or store your location.
Erosion is testing the Contacts permission prompt. Prepare does not read or store your contacts.
Erosion is testing the Face ID system interface. Prepare does not store biometric data.
Erosion is testing the Bluetooth permission prompt. Prepare does not scan for or connect to nearby devices.
